CSVインポートに加えて、指定されたディレクトリ構造からMarkdownファイルをインポートする機能を実装しました。

## 実装内容

### UI改善
- 「Markdownインポート」ボタンを新規追加
- 既存の「インポート」ボタンを「CSVインポート」に明確化して区別

### Markdownインポート機能
指定されたディレクトリ構造（`{回}/{セクション}/{回}-{セクション}-{ID}.md`）からMarkdownファイルを読み込み、以下のフォーマットに対応：

```markdown
## 確認テスト利用
TRUE

## 単位認定試験利用
FALSE

## ID
1

## 回
1

## セクション
1

## 想定難易度
1(90％程度正答)

## 問題文
問題文の内容

## 選択肢A
選択肢Aの内容

## 選択肢B
選択肢Bの内容

## 選択肢C
選択肢Cの内容

## 選択肢D
選択肢Dの内容

## 正解
選択肢A

## 解説
解説の内容
```

### 技術的実装
- **File System Access API**を使用したディレクトリ選択
- 再帰的なディレクトリ traversal でファイルを自動検出
- Markdownファイルの段落構造を解析してQuestion オブジェクトに変換
- 同一IDの問題は後勝ちで上書き（CSVインポートと同じ動作）

### エラーハンドリング
- 不正なMarkdownファイルの詳細なエラー表示
- 一部ファイルが失敗した場合の選択的インポート機能
- 成功・失敗件数の明確な表示
- ブラウザ非対応時の適切なエラーメッセージ

## 動作環境
File System Access APIを使用するため、Chrome/Edge系ブラウザ + HTTPS（またはlocalhost）環境が必要です。

## テスト結果
- ✅ Markdownファイルの正常解析
- ✅ エラーハンドリングの動作確認
- ✅ 既存CSVインポート機能の互換性維持
- ✅ TypeScript/Viteビルドの成功

![Markdownインポート機能のUI](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e41ce14b-0080-4c4b-8e6d-c2d0cd4d6cff)

Fixes #9.

Following up on the discussion in https://github.com/eschnett/SIMD.jl/issues/141#issuecomment-3214671776, this PR defines:
```
bitmaskconvert(UInt, SIMD.Vec)
bitmaskconvert(SIMD.Vec, UInt)
```

This function replaces `bitmask` and provide a general interface for converting from a vector of booleans to a uint and vice versa.

There are specific cases where it's very convenient to avoid specifying the output type, for those cases `tobitmask(SIMD.Vec)` and `frombitmask(UInt)` were added. However, these are mostly "convenience" functions so they aren't strictly necessary.

# Summary 

Today, Zed uses Mold on Linux, but Wild can be significantly faster. 

On my machine, Wild is 14% faster at a whole-tree clean build, 20% faster on an incremental build with a minimal change, and makes no measurable effect on runtime performance of tests.

However, Wild's page says it's not yet ready for production, so it seems to early to switch for production and CI builds.

This PR keeps using Mold in CI and lets developers choose in their own config what linker to use. (The downside of this is that after landing this change, developers will have to do some local config or it will fall back to the default linker which may be slower.)

[Wild 0.6 is out, and their announcement has some benchmarks](https://davidlattimore.github.io/posts/2025/09/23/wild-update-0.6.0.html).

author: yjsoon
body:
## Summary

This PR fixes the long-standing bug where users would get a "Template not found" error when pressing Generate for the first time after uploading an image and adding text. They had to press Generate twice for it to work.

## Root Cause

The issue was a race condition where:
1. File was uploaded client-side only (stored as a File object)
2. When Generate was pressed, it would upload to server via `ensureFileUploadedForServer`
3. But `generateIndividualPdfs` was using the old `uploadedFile` value (File object) before the state updated with the server filename

## Solution

- Modified `ensureFileUploadedForServer` to return the uploaded filename after successful upload
- Updated `generateIndividualPdfs` and `startProgressiveGeneration` to accept an optional filename parameter
- Pass the fresh filename from upload directly to the generation functions, avoiding race conditions

## Changes

- `hooks/usePdfGeneration.ts` - Added optional filename parameter to `generateIndividualPdfs`
- `hooks/useProgressivePdfGeneration.ts` - Added optional filename parameter to `startProgressiveGeneration`
- `hooks/usePdfGenerationMethods.tsx` - Modified to upload file first and pass the returned filename to generation functions
- `pages/index.tsx` - Added `uploadedFile` prop to the hooks
- `TODO.md` - Marked issue as resolved

## Testing

- ✅ Unit tests pass
- ✅ Build succeeds
- ✅ Manual testing confirms the bug is fixed

This resolves the first high-priority item in TODO.md.
